# Toponium K-factors (colour singlet + octet), p p -> t t~, 13 TeV, LO MadGraph5_aMC@NLO 2.9.27, CT25NNLO (run run6_final_kfactors_13TeV)
# K = sigma(with toponium) / sigma(SM) per bin; multiply the SM prediction of the bin by K.
# K_norm = K / K over the whole binning: use it for distributions normalised to their own integral.
# stat_err: MC statistics. model_unc: p* cut (100 vs 50 GeV) and octet potential (4 versions), in quadrature.
# Bins: lower edge included, upper excluded; tops = parton level (b + l + nu).
